newsitem.title: UK: UK's Sears same-store sales up 2.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: UK's Sears same-store sales up 2.5 pct.

text.p: British retailer Sears Plc said on Tuesday its like-for-like sales rose by 2.5 percent in the 19 weeks to June 14.
The increase marked a slowdown from the 5.3 percent rise the company previously reported for the first 11 weeks of the year, Sears said.

"Despite the slowdown in like-for-like sales in the last few weeks, we have two robust businesses in Selfridges and Clothing, about which we remain cautiously optimistic for the full year," Sears said in a statement from its annual meeting.
Sears' shares slid 2.0p to 67.5 by 1030 GMT.
Like-for-like sales at Selfridges rose 6.3 percent in the 19-week period, including the effect of Sunda trading, which started last July.
Meanwhile, same-store sales at its UK womenswear business jumped 13.5 percent, boosted by the rollout of a new store format.
Like-for-like sales in home shopping fell by 1.7 percent, while footwear division sales declined 1.3 percent, the company said. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
